prompt: What was the 2021 population of the birthplace of the leader of the party that won the 1869 Newfoundland general election?
answer:
The party that won the 1869 Newfoundland general election was the **Anti-Confederation Party**, led by **Charles Fox Bennett**. Bennett was born in **St. John’s, Newfoundland**.

According to the **2021 Canadian Census**, St. John’s had a population of **110,525** (city proper).
